title: AEyeDE：基于注意力的AI生成文本检测框架
summary: 提出AEyeDE框架，利用代理Transformer模型的注意力归因矩阵作为判别信号，通过轻量级CNN学习表征，在编码器-解码器和解码器设置中均优于文本基线，且对跨数据集和扰动具有鲁棒性。
summary_en: Proposes AEyeDE, an attribution-driven framework that uses attention matrices from a proxy Transformer as discriminative signals for AI-generated text detection, outperforming text-only baselines and showing robustness across datasets and perturbations.
